results.justification: Old EX-os-MEM-1 (no null/empty-chunk guard before dereferencing the chunk returned by duckdb_fetch_chunk, examples/online_scoring.py:123-136) is the same root-cause defect reported by current EX-os-MEM-2 ("No NULL/size guard on fetched chunk before dereferencing it", line 123) and EX-os-COR-2 ("No chunk_p != 0 / empty-result guard before dereferencing the fetched chunk", line 123). Same file, same read path (get_vector -> vector_get_data -> carray[0] on a possibly-NULL/empty chunk), same data-construction-gated trigger.

Old EX-os-MEM-2 (prepared statement leaked when duckdb_prepare fails / no try/finally, examples/online_scoring.py:155-161) is the same defect as current EX-os-MEM-1 ("Prepared statement not destroyed on any error path (no try/finally)", line 156) and EX-os-COR-1 ("Prepared statement leaked when duckdb_prepare fails", line 156). Identical root cause: the assert rc == DuckDBSuccess short-circuits duckdb_destroy_prepare, leaking the C-side handle that DuckDB allocates even on error.
